parameters.content:
## Before testing
1. Open **EDIT ME - Approval Config** and set the approver name/email.
2. Select your Supabase credentials on all Supabase nodes.
3. Select Gmail credentials on requester notification nodes.
4. Select Bearer Auth credentials on MCP client nodes.
5. Re-select the MCP upload tool if your imported workflow IDs/tool names differ.
6. Manual test uses `request_id = 1`.

parameters.jsCode:
const p = $('Build Approval Packet').first().json;
const approval = $('Create Pending Approval').first().json;

const poRef = `PROC-PO-${p.request_id}-${approval.id}`;
const date = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

const lines = [
  'PURCHASE ORDER DRAFT',
  '====================',
  '',
  `PO Reference: ${poRef}`,
  `Date: ${date}`,
  `Purchase Request ID: ${p.request_id}`,
  `Approval ID: ${approval.id}`,
  '',
  'ISSUED BY',
  `Department: ${p.po_issuer}`,
  '',
  'VENDOR',
  `Vendor: ${p.vendor_name}`,
  `Contact: ${p.vendor_contact || 'N/A'}`,
  `Email: ${p.vendor_email || 'N/A'}`,
  `Phone: ${p.vendor_phone || 'N/A'}`,
  '',
  'PURCHASE DETAILS',
  `Item: ${p.item_name}`,
  `Description: ${p.description || 'N/A'}`,
  `Quantity: ${p.quantity}`,
  `Quoted Total: ${p.currency} ${Number(p.quoted_amount).toLocaleString('en-US')}`,
  `Delivery: ${p.delivery_days ?? 'N/A'} days`,
  `Warranty: ${p.warranty_months ?? 'N/A'} months`,
  `Payment Terms: ${p.payment_terms || 'N/A'}`,
  '',
  'SOURCE & APPROVAL',
  `Quotation ID: ${p.quotation_id}`,
  `Approved By: ${p.approver_name}`,
  `Approval Status: APPROVED`,
  '',
  'IMPORTANT',
  'This document is an automatically generated PO DRAFT. It must be reviewed and formally authorized before being issued to the vendor.'
];

return [{
  json: {
    po_reference: poRef,
    po_name: `${poRef} - ${p.vendor_name}`,
    po_content: lines.join('\n')
  }
}];
